verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents rule-based automations that run in the background without user intervention: automatic error assignment rules (bugsnag-docs-2), PagerDuty incidents created when errors arrive (bugsnag-docs-9), webhook forwarding as events are processed (bugsnag-docs-10), and Slack/Teams alerts (bugsnag-docs-7). These are fixed event-triggered rules and notifications, not configurable autonomous or agentic workflows. Missing for 10: user-defined multi-step or scheduled automation workflows, AI or agent-driven autonomous actions (such as auto-triage or auto-fix), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the automation features.
